text: DSH Tool Search 是 DSH Web 客户端的工具发现插件，可按任务或名称搜索内置、插件及 MCP 工具。它注册 tool_search 和 tool_unload，并将搜索到的原生 schema 提供给 agent 后续步骤。支持 BM25、模式匹配及可选的 Ollama 或 OpenAI-compatible 混合语义检索，也能配置常用工具并卸载暂时不用的 schema。适合希望按需发现工具、减少上下文负担的用户。嵌入可关闭；启用时需配置对应服务，默认 OpenAI 服务需要凭据。

DSH Tool Search finds built-in DSH, plugin, and MCP tools by task or name. Search and unload tools expose schemas to the agent’s next step and remove unused ones. It supports BM25, pattern matching, and optional embeddings through Ollama or OpenAI-compatible services. Embeddings can be disabled.
我想让 agent 需要时再查找可用的 DSH 工具。
能不能按一句任务描述找到对应的插件工具？
如何搜索已经接入的 MCP 工具并加载它的参数 schema？
DSH 每轮带的工具定义太多，想按需显示。
我知道工具的准确名称，想直接查它是否可用。
想用本地 BM25 搜索工具，不调用嵌入服务。
Find an installed DSH or MCP tool from a task description and load its schema.
Can I keep tool schemas out of the context until an agent needs them?
Search available tools by exact name or keywords, then unload them when done.
DSH Tool Search 的功能「按任务发现工具」：agent 可用关键词或准确工具名检索内置、插件及 MCP 工具，搜索返回匹配项和原生 schema。调用 tool_search；结果供 agent 后续步骤使用。
DSH Tool Search 的功能「按需加载 schema」：搜索匹配后将选中工具的 schema 加入当前 agent 的可用集合，并限制额外加载数量。agent 先完成搜索，再在下一步调用新工具。
DSH Tool Search 的功能「卸载工具 schema」：agent 可通过 tool_unload 按名称移除已发现的工具，或省略名称清除额外加载的工具；基础工具仍保留。
DSH Tool Search 的功能「混合语义检索」：可配置 Ollama 或 OpenAI-compatible 嵌入，将向量语义与 BM25 搜索结合；关闭嵌入时仍可使用 BM25。
DSH Tool Search 的 OpenAI-compatible 嵌入会将搜索文本发送到所配置的嵌入 API；使用默认 OpenAI 服务需配置凭据。关闭嵌入后可使用 BM25 而不发起嵌入请求。
DSH Tool Search 默认通过本机 Ollama 地址生成嵌入，模型由用户自行安装；远程 Ollama 地址默认不启用，需显式允许。

@swimmwatch/dsh-tool-search README · DSH Tool Search： [](https://github.com/swimmwatch/dsh-tool-search/actions/workflows/ci.yml) A native [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) plugin that finds tools when an AI agent needs them. It searches built-in DSH tools, plugin tools and MCP tools, then exposes the selected schemas on the next agent step. Search does not execute tools or change their permissions.

@swimmwatch/dsh-tool-search README · DSH Tool Search：Keep a small, configurable set of tools always available; discover the rest with
`tool_search` and remove unused schemas with `tool_unload`. Each agent has its
own set of up to 16 additional tools. Native and PTC presets are supported.

Use local **BM25 tool search**, or add **semantic search** through Ollama or an
OpenAI-compatible embeddings API. It works with Model Context Protocol (MCP)
tools alongside native tools, without running another MCP server.
@swimmwatch/dsh-tool-search README · DSH Tool Search：

@swimmwatch/dsh-tool-search README · Requirements：- DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2** and **Node.js 24**.
- A working DSH profile; the examples below use `web`.
- Embeddings are optional. Search works without Ollama or an API key when
  **Use embeddings** is off.

The npm package is **`@swimmwatch/dsh-tool-search`**. The unscoped
`dsh-tool-search` package belongs to another project.

@swimmwatch/dsh-tool-search README · Install：Install the stable release into your DSH profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @swimmwatch/dsh-tool-search@latest
```

To try a published release candidate:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @swimmwatch/dsh-tool-search@next
```

@swimmwatch/dsh-tool-search README · Install：For reproducibility, replace the tag with an exact published version. You can
also download a prebuilt `.tgz` and `SHA256SUMS` from
[GitHub Releases](https://github.com/swimmwatch/dsh-tool-search/releases), verify
its SHA-256, and pass its absolute path to the same installation command.
Follow DSH's reload/restart message. Do not use `npm install -g`: DSH activates
plugins through profile bundles, not npm's global package directory.

@swimmwatch/dsh-tool-search README · Use：The agent first searches for a capability:

```json
{ "query": "workflow", "limit": 1, "mode": "bm25" }
```

Pass this to `tool_search`. After it returns, the next model step receives the
original `workflow` schema. The agent can then call `workflow` with the arguments
required by that schema and the usual DSH permission checks.

```text
Always-available tools + tool_search
                |
          search a capability
                |

@swimmwatch/dsh-tool-search README · Use：`tool_search` defaults to hybrid search with three results (maximum five).
Use an exact tool name or a focused task description. An empty query returns a
compact inventory. `tool_unload({"names":["workflow"]})` removes a discovered
schema; `tool_unload({})` removes all additionally loaded schemas. Tools configured
as always available cannot be unloaded.

@swimmwatch/dsh-tool-search README · Configure：- **Always available tools:** one tool name per line. The default includes 39
  tools for files, workflows, background jobs, scheduling, goals and agents.
  `tool_search` and `tool_unload` always remain available.
- **Use embeddings:** turn off for fully local BM25 search, with no embedding
  network requests. This intentional mode is not reported as degraded.
- **Ollama:** default provider, model `qwen3-embedding:4b`. Install your selected
  model yourself; the plugin never downloads models.
- **OpenAI-compatible:** set model, API base URL and credential reference.
  Defaults are `text-embedding-3-small` and `https://api.openai.com/v1`.
  Save keys through the DSH credential control; stored plaintext is never shown.
  This control requires a writable DSH credential service. If it is unavailable,
  supply `DSH_TOOL_SEARCH_OPENAI_API_KEY` in the DSH process environment instead.

@swimmwatch/dsh-tool-search README · Privacy and limitations：The vector cache stores hashes and vectors under `$DSH_HOME/cache/dsh-tool-search`,
not queries, raw catalogs or keys. Search preserves registry scope and DSH access
checks. Unloading schemas does not remove earlier conversation messages, skill
catalogs or tool results. Smaller schema payloads do not by themselves prove
lower total task cost; include caching and extra search calls in comparisons.

@swimmwatch/dsh-tool-search README · Privacy and limitations：See [tool/provider details](docs/reference.md), the
[public contract](docs/public-contract.md) and [benchmark methodology](benchmarks/README.md).

@swimmwatch/dsh-tool-search README · Update or remove：Update with the installation command and an explicit version or release tag.
To remove the plugin:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove @swimmwatch/dsh-tool-search
```

Follow DSH's restart instructions. Disabling/removing the plugin unregisters its
tools and filtering; the underlying DSH/plugin/MCP tools remain registered.

npm ci
npm run check

CI also checks installation, repository policy, secrets, dependency security and
